entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I need to return something. I think. The website was so confusing, I couldn't figure it out. It's a helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your order, could I please get your name and the order number?
My name is Alex Smith. The order number is... umm, let me see... VF789012. I hope that's right. I'm just so overwhelmed with all this.

No problem at all, Alex. Let me pull that up for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the Summit Pro helmet, delivered on September 20th. It's been about 81 days. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, it's not broken. It was a gift, and the color is just... not right. I thought about keeping it, but I just won't use it. The box is still unopened, completely sealed. I worry about safety with helmets, you know? I want to get one that I'll actually wear. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I understand completely. Let me just double-check our return policy for you.
Okay, I've checked the policy. Since the helmet was delivered 81 days ago, it's still well within our 90-day return window for standard items. We can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief! I was so worried it had been too long. Thank you.

You're very welcome, Alex. I'm happy I could make this easy for you. I've just emailed you a prepaid return shipping label. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
